segment.source: Renders the trail from the site root down to the current page as a row of links, collapsing the middle behind an ellipsis when it grows past the width. Use it for: the top of a deep detail page, a step inside a long section, any page that search engines drop readers into without context. Prefer 'Back to Section' when one link upwards is enough, and 'Sitemap Tree' when the reader needs the whole structure rather than their own path.
